text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Aw, shucks... And after getting so
close...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess I didn't want it as much as I
should have. If
I'd just pushed myself a
little h—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No. Coulda, shoulda, wouldas aside, a
loss is a
loss.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have to accept the results and move
forward.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for saying that.
It really helps.
choice_data_list: You can learn from failure, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Let's start training for my next
race right
away.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know that. I'm not saying we should
ignore what
happened.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I just won't let it bring me down either.
That's all.
